transform.description: Trim surrounding whitespace and convert the value to text.

field_mappings.rationale: TreeID is the only candidate key and its name matches. 97 repeated IDs are copies of earlier rows, which the upsert on external_id writes once.

transform.description: Trim whitespace, group values case-insensitively, replace each with the most frequent spelling in its group, and turn blanks into null.

field_mappings.rationale: The target asks for the common English name, which is what 'Species (common)' holds; 'Latin Name' competes but holds scientific names. Casing varies (London planetree / LONDON PLANETREE).

transform.description: Replace each Status variant with the matching target value and reject any value not in the map.

field_mappings.rationale: Name and values match the target enum one-to-one once casing and the letters A and D are normalized.

transform.description: Replace each condition variant with the lower-case target value, turn blanks into null, and reject any other value.

field_mappings.rationale: 'Cond.' is abbreviated, but its values are exactly Good/Fair/Poor plus single letters. The 212 blanks are stumps and dead trees, which the target leaves empty.

transform.description: Use Stump Dia when Status maps to stump and DBH otherwise; strip any unit text, parse the number, multiply by 2.54 and round to 1 decimal.

field_mappings.rationale: DBH is diameter at breast height in inches, but it is 0 on all 141 stump rows, whose size is in Stump Dia. Mapped with the recommended answer to q1.

transform.description: Remove parentheses and spaces, split on the comma, and parse the first part as a decimal.

field_mappings.rationale: The first number in Location is always between 40.4 and 40.9, which is New York latitude.

transform.description: Remove parentheses and spaces, split on the comma, and parse the second part as a decimal.

field_mappings.rationale: The second number in Location is always between -74.3 and -73.7, which is New York longitude.

transform.description: Replace each borough spelling or code with the full borough name and reject any value not in the map.

field_mappings.rationale: 'Boro' is abbreviated, but its values are the five boroughs written as full names, codes and short forms.

transform.description: Parse the date with each input format in order and keep the first that succeeds.

field_mappings.rationale: Slash dates have a second part above 12 (08/27/2015), so they are month-first; the other two formats are unambiguous.

questions.question: The 141 stump rows have DBH = 0 and their size in 'Stump Dia'. What should diameter_cm hold for stumps?

options.label: Stump diameter for stumps, DBH for the rest
options.effect: Stump rows get their stump diameter in centimeters.

options.label: Leave diameter empty for stumps
options.effect: Stump rows get null instead of 0.

options.label: Use DBH for every row
options.effect: Stump rows are written with diameter_cm = 0.
